headline.text: L2 FFS ran out of film at 07:14 and shut down after producing *9,063 cases short* of target — line clearing for changeover.

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 ran caramel almond all shift with recurring mini-temper instability — line stopped at 07:10 without temper at decorator. S3 mac nut cluster ran clean through 3 shifts; brought nut usage down to 2.05% and piece count to target. Labeler feed issue unresolved.
per_plant_summary.L2: FFS consumed final film roll and shut down at 07:14 due to material shortage, 9,063 cases short of plan. ML2 ran all shift with multiple brief blade and cooler stops, all cleared inside 10 minutes. ML3 passed off and started tempering for next run. Panning team found mislabeled Private Select mac nuts; pallet placed on hold.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 had two brief line-down events for gondola jams (cleared in under 20 minutes each); gondola routing to TG5 remains intermittent, requiring TG4 stops. Truffle line ran Hershey bite through 1st shift, paused twice for Cavanna 1 infeed issues (fixed), then changed to toffee flavor at 05:50. MF Matrix batch out of spec at startup, maintenance adjusting. ML1 Donner belt 1 misaligned, maintenance notified.

notes.text: Flagstone macadamia delivery received after COA request cleared; now in system.
Erandy updated and laminated mini-temper startup checklist, left with other S2 checklists.
Aasted rebuild tech expected at 08:00 MT per Chad Stone.

resolved.title: S2 mini-temper lost temper, line stopped 18:11
resolved.summary: Decorator mini-temper would not achieve temper; Dakota stopped line at 18:11.
resolved.resolution: Dakota and Justin agreed to reheat cycle. Elizabeth reported temper at 21:11, line restarted at 21:23 — 3 hours 12 minutes total (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: S2 mini-temper gearbox replacement
resolved.summary: Scheduled gearbox swap on mini-tempering unit; line held for maintenance and ATP.
resolved.resolution: Victor Romero: gearbox installed, ATP passed, QC approved at 09:13. Mariela confirmed mini-temper clean and ATP pass at 09:20.

resolved.title: S3 piece count 52–54 per jar (target 46)
resolved.summary: First jars off S3 packing at 07:51 contained 52 and 54 pieces; max spec is 47.
resolved.resolution: Nathan turned off shaker, adjusted bottoming roller 70%→100%, wire mesh 4.2→4.0. Ingrid confirmed jars at 46 pieces by 08:38.

resolved.title: S2 separating belt replacement
resolved.summary: Separation belt cooked overnight, cooled, tested, and replaced per schedule.
resolved.resolution: Victor: belt replacement complete, ATP at 5 points all pass (0), sanitizer applied. QC approved at 10:38 (Victor Romero Sr., Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: S2 MM-6 and MM-8 multi-mould faults
resolved.summary: Multi-mould machines 6 and 8 cycling faults at 16:05; product not dropping into pouches.
resolved.resolution: Caleb York: MM-6 good, MM-8 good shortly (16:16). Elizabeth: 13-minute pause to clear backlog, both running at 16:55.

resolved.title: S3 tray printer air fault recurrence on 2nd shift
resolved.summary: Same air pressure issue returned on 2nd shift tray printer.
resolved.resolution: William followed Troy's instructions; got printer running at 16:15 (William Beattie).

resolved.title: S2 MM-7 product not dropping
resolved.summary: Multi-mould 7 hopper blocked; product not feeding into pouches at 22:28.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance cleared; MM-7 working at 23:02 (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: S2 decorator temper spiked into red
resolved.summary: Decorator temper rose out of range at 01:44; product risk.
resolved.resolution: Joseph decreased mini-temper set point 0.2°; temper returned to range by 02:31.

resolved.title: S2 almond missing from tank, then found
resolved.summary: Karen noticed nut missing from caramel tank at 04:21 — foreign material risk.
resolved.resolution: Piece located and recovered at 04:24; line continued (Karen Velastegui).

resolved.title: S3 tray printer air pressure fault
resolved.summary: Tray date-code printer faulting on air pressure; Troy diagnosed bad regulator at 08:23.
resolved.resolution: Troy swapped regulator from S2; printer working (Troy Baxter, 08:23).

resolved.title: ML2 blade cutting failure (3 stops)
resolved.summary: Flow wrapper blade failed to cut pouches; line stopped at 08:01, 08:42, and 10:15.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance shimmed blades; final restart at 10:25. No further blade stops through shift (Alex Mendoza, Claudio Tovar).

resolved.title: Sorting machine camera fault

resolved.title: ML2 cooler jam

resolved.title: ML2 demolder fault
resolved.summary: Demolding station faulted, stopped line at 17:06.
resolved.resolution: Back running at 17:09 — 3 minutes (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: Darker macadamia nuts in sorted product

resolved.resolution: Wilson separated suspect nuts and ran test lot through sorter; confirmed sorter detects and rejects them. Tote released at 20:39 (Wilson Amaris Cabrera).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 recurring faults after repair

resolved.resolution: Maintenance worked through issue; 25-minute pause to clear 20+ bins. Line stable after 08:41 (Frederick Peairs).
